mapper.insert: insert into warehouse_stock (warehouse_id, product_id, available_qty, locked_qty, total_qty, is_del, create_time, update_time) values (#{warehouseId}, #{productId}, #{availableQty}, #{lockedQty}, #{totalQty}, #{isDel}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, warehouse_id, product_id, available_qty, locked_qty, total_qty, is_del, create_time, update_time from warehouse_stock where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
mapper.update: update warehouse_stock set available_qty = #{availableQty}, locked_qty = #{lockedQty}, total_qty = #{totalQty}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and is_del = 0
